security_audit.summary: Forty static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown fences, inline code, metadata URLs, and fixed relative links. One connector command is confirmed, and its live suppression mode lacks explicit per-action approval.

remediation.issue: Live ESP suppression can change subscriber state without explicit per-action approval.
remediation.suggestion: Require clear user confirmation immediately before --live, validate the contact identifier, and show the intended change before execution.

content.value_statement: Email teams often lack consistent, consent-aware audience definitions. This skill converts owned exports into measurable behavioral, RFM, lifecycle, and suppression segments.
actual_capabilities: Profiles available columns in CRM, ESP, analytics, and ecommerce exports.
Creates behavioral segments from engagement and commerce activity.
Builds RFM tiers when recency, frequency, and monetary fields exist.
Maps lifecycle stages with reusable, measurable rules.
Creates suppression criteria and reconciles available consent records.
Labels audience counts as Measured or Estimated and states the method.
limitations: Does not send email, create campaign content, or design lifecycle flows.
Requires user-provided exports; most external platforms are not queried automatically.
Cannot produce reliable RFM tiers without order data.
Does not verify authentication, sender reputation, spam content, or overall email quality.

use_cases.title: Plan a Retention Campaign
use_cases.description: Create engaged, at-risk, lapsed, and win-back audiences from recent subscriber activity.

use_cases.title: Build Ecommerce RFM Tiers
use_cases.description: Group customers by purchase recency, frequency, and value for targeted commerce campaigns.

use_cases.title: Reconcile Suppression Rules
use_cases.description: Identify unsubscribed, bounced, complained, withdrawn, and undocumented consent cohorts before audience handoff.

prompt_templates.title: Segment a List Export
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze [CSV path] for [goal]. Build behavioral and lifecycle segments, create suppression rules, and label every count Measured or Estimated.
prompt_templates.scenario: Start with one subscriber export and a clear campaign goal.

prompt_templates.title: Build RFM Tiers
prompt_templates.prompt: Use [order export] and [subscriber export] to create RFM tiers. State thresholds, counts, missing fields, and suppression conflicts.
prompt_templates.scenario: Combine purchase history with subscriber status.

prompt_templates.title: Reconcile Consent
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [segment export] with consent records. Identify excluded cohorts, missing consent evidence, and reusable suppression rules without displaying personal data.
prompt_templates.scenario: Validate audience eligibility before campaign preparation.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Reusable Segment System
prompt_templates.prompt: Create behavioral, RFM, and lifecycle definitions across [exports]. Resolve overlaps, explain precedence, quantify each audience, and prepare a handoff summary.
prompt_templates.scenario: Standardize audiences across several campaign types.

output_examples.input: Retention goal with subscriber activity, bounce status, and consent fields.
output: Engaged 90 days: 8,420 measured from open and click dates.
Lapsed: 2,180 measured with no engagement during the selected window.
Suppressed: 614 measured from unsubscribe, hard-bounce, complaint, and withdrawal fields.

output_examples.input: Ecommerce order export joined with subscriber status.
output: Champions: recent, frequent, high-value purchasers; 1,204 measured.
At-risk: previously frequent purchasers beyond the recency threshold; 892 measured.
Missing consent evidence: 76 records marked NEEDS_INPUT and excluded from mailable counts.

best_practices: Provide exports with clear timestamps, status fields, and column definitions.
Confirm the campaign goal before selecting engagement windows or segment priorities.
Review suppression rules and consent evidence before using any segment downstream.
anti_patterns: Do not assume missing consent records mean a subscriber is opted in.
Do not present inferred audience sizes as measured counts.
Do not include raw email addresses or phone numbers in summaries.

faq.question: Which files can this skill analyze?
faq.answer: It can use CRM, ESP, GA4, ecommerce, order, and consent exports supplied by the user.

faq.question: Can it create RFM tiers without order data?
faq.answer: No. It marks the RFM bucket as NEEDS_INPUT when recency, frequency, or monetary fields are unavailable.

faq.question: How are segment sizes reported?
faq.answer: Each size is labeled Measured or Estimated, with the counting or inference method stated.

faq.question: Does it send campaigns?
faq.answer: No. It defines audiences and suppression rules for downstream campaign and sequence tools.

faq.question: How does it handle personal data?
faq.answer: It works from aggregate counts, rules, and hashed descriptions instead of displaying raw personal records.

faq.question: Can it synchronize segments to an email platform?
faq.answer: Most platforms require manual exports. Resend connector commands are documented, but live changes should require explicit confirmation.
